_comment: Tier-2 for kratos structural_dynamics: FALSIFIES the pre-2026-08-03 catalog claim that a wrong Bossak key name is 'silently ignored and the scheme runs without damping'. Kratos Parameters::ValidateAndAssignDefaults rejects unknown keys, so a real dynamic StructuralMechanicsAnalysis with 'alpha_m' instead of 'damp_factor_m' aborts with 'Error: The item with name "alpha_m" is present in this Parameters but NOT in the default values' before the first time step, while the same case with 'damp_factor_m' runs to completion. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 on Kratos 10.4.0. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 uses the documented key damp_factor_m in place of the unknown alpha_m, both in the ValidateAndAssignDefaults probe and in the full dynamic analysis; validation then accepts the block and the analysis runs. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: validate_unknown_key_raises=True, validate_message_mentions_not_in_default_values=True, wrong_key_aborts_the_run=True, wrong_key_is_silently_ignored=False. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/parameters_unknown_key_raises && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers. HARNESS FIX 2026-08-07: this fixture printed its assertion lines immediately after Kratos had written to stdout from C++ without a trailing newline, so the runner saw them glued to the tail of a Kratos log line (e.g. '::[MPMSolver]:: : Solinitialises[Background_Grid]=True_expected=True'). The runner's left-edge guard then correctly refused to match an assertion that does not begin a token, and every run was recorded FAIL although the fixture exits 0 and its mutation control still turns it red. A blank print() now forces a line boundary before the assertion block. No assertion, probe or expectation changed.
